title: `docker run`: ports, variables, resource limits and restart policy

videos.script: Until now Ana's containers ran with whatever docker run gives by default. This lesson goes through the flags that change that. {{ports}} First, ports. A container has its own network, so nothing reaches it until a port is published. And a port published without an address is open to every machine that can reach this one. {{env}} Then configuration, through environment variables. Easy to set, and easy to read back, password included. {{limits}} Then limits. With none, one container can take all of the memory. With one, the kernel stops it. {{restart}} And last, what happens when the program exits. By default, nothing. A restart policy decides otherwise.
